summary.text: Erica Layon is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 13 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Republican primary.
She holds an economics degree and has worked as an options market maker on Wall Street and as a medical device analyst.

paragraphs.text: Erica Layon lives in New Hampshire and earned a bachelor's degree in economics from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology in 2001.
Her career experience includes work as an economist with the Massachusetts Institute of Technology, an options market maker on Wall Street, and a medical device analyst.
Ballotpedia's campaign contribution history lists general-election wins for Layon in Rockingham 6 in 2020 and in Rockingham 13 in 2024.
She was assigned to the Health, Human Services and Elderly Affairs Committee as vice chair for the 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions, and to the House Education Committee for 2021-2022.
